FX-SCRIBBLE-001.says: The settings as added on the box from (2, 2) to (13, 7): white lines 5 wide at 45 degrees, 5 apart, a little curved and wiggling, covering most of the box.

FX-SCRIBBLE-002.says: Angle 0, Stroke Width 1, Spacing 2.5, no curve or wiggle: two red lines across the box at y 3.25 and 5.75, joined at the right by a straight turn, a Z laid on its side.

FX-SCRIBBLE-003.says: FX-SCRIBBLE-002 at Angle 90: the lines run up the box, 2.5 apart from its left side.

FX-SCRIBBLE-004.says: FX-SCRIBBLE-002 at Angle 30: sloped lines, each cut where it leaves the box.

FX-SCRIBBLE-006.says: FX-SCRIBBLE-002 with Curviness 100: each turn a round loop out past the box's side.

FX-SCRIBBLE-007.says: FX-SCRIBBLE-002 with Spacing 1.5: four lines, closer.

FX-SCRIBBLE-008.says: FX-SCRIBBLE-002 with Stroke Width 2: thicker lines.

FX-SCRIBBLE-009.says: FX-SCRIBBLE-002 with Path Overlap 1.5: each line runs 1.5 past the box at both ends.

FX-SCRIBBLE-010.says: FX-SCRIBBLE-002 with Path Overlap -3: each line pulled 3 inside the box at both ends.

FX-SCRIBBLE-011.says: FX-SCRIBBLE-002 with Opacity 50: half covered at most.

FX-SCRIBBLE-012.says: FX-SCRIBBLE-002 On Transparent: the lines alone, the cel gone.

FX-SCRIBBLE-013.says: FX-SCRIBBLE-002 Reveal Original Image: the cel only under the lines.

FX-SCRIBBLE-014.says: FX-SCRIBBLE-002 with Stroke Width 0: nothing drawn, the cel as it was.

FX-SCRIBBLE-015.says: FX-SCRIBBLE-002 with End 50: only the first half of the scribble's length.

FX-SCRIBBLE-016.says: Start 30 and End 80 at Spacing 1.5: the middle half.

FX-SCRIBBLE-017.says: End keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 8: the scribble draws on, nothing at frame 0, the whole at frame 8.

FX-SCRIBBLE-018.says: Fill Type Centered Edge, Edge Width 2: lines over the band 1 each side of the box's outline, a gap in the middle.

FX-SCRIBBLE-019.says: Fill Type Inside Edge, Edge Width 2: the band 2 inside the outline.

FX-SCRIBBLE-020.says: Fill Type Outside Edge, Edge Width 1.5: the band 1.5 outside the outline.

FX-SCRIBBLE-021.says: Right Edge on the box drawn clockwise: FX-SCRIBBLE-019's frame.

FX-SCRIBBLE-022.says: Left Edge on the box drawn clockwise: the outside band, as Outside Edge at Edge Width 2.

FX-SCRIBBLE-023.says: Left Edge on the box drawn the other way: the inside band, FX-SCRIBBLE-019's frame.

FX-SCRIBBLE-024.says: A curved mask, a circle 8 across: the lines cut at its curve.

FX-SCRIBBLE-025.says: A concave arrow head: on the lines that cross it twice the pen lifts over the notch.

FX-SCRIBBLE-026.says: Two masks, Mask 2: the small box alone.

FX-SCRIBBLE-027.says: Two overlapping boxes, All Masks, Fill Paths Sequentially on, End 50: each box scribbled on its own, one length, so only the first box's lines and part of the second's.

FX-SCRIBBLE-028.says: FX-SCRIBBLE-027 with Fill Paths Sequentially off: each box trimmed to its own half.

FX-SCRIBBLE-029.says: All Masks Using Modes, the second box Add: one region, both boxes together, On Transparent.

FX-SCRIBBLE-030.says: Using Modes, the second box Subtract: the first box less the second.

FX-SCRIBBLE-031.says: Using Modes, the second box Intersect: their common part only.

FX-SCRIBBLE-032.says: Using Modes, the second box Difference: either but not both.

FX-SCRIBBLE-033.says: Using Modes, the second box Add and inverted: the first box and everything outside the second.

FX-SCRIBBLE-034.says: Using Modes with a single mask in Subtract: the whole buffer less the box.

FX-SCRIBBLE-035.says: Using Modes, the second mask of mode None: left out, the first box alone.

FX-SCRIBBLE-036.says: Single Mask on an inverted mask: inversion is not used outside Using Modes, FX-SCRIBBLE-002's frame.

FX-SCRIBBLE-037.says: Variations on, Wiggle Type Static: uneven spacing, overshoots and loops, the same at every frame.

FX-SCRIBBLE-038.says: The same, Jumpy at 6 a second: a new scribble every 4 frames, frames 0 and 2 alike, 4 new.

FX-SCRIBBLE-039.says: The same, Smooth: frame 2 half way between frames 0 and 4's scribbles.

FX-SCRIBBLE-040.says: FX-SCRIBBLE-037 with Random Seed 7: a different scribble.

FX-SCRIBBLE-041.says: Smooth at 0 wiggles a second: still, every frame FX-SCRIBBLE-037's.

FX-SCRIBBLE-042.says: FX-SCRIBBLE-002 with the layer moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-SCRIBBLE-043.says: Mask 1.5: its floor, mask 1, FX-SCRIBBLE-002's frame.

FX-SCRIBBLE-044.says: A mask of two points encloses nothing: Inside draws nothing; Centered Edge, FX-SCRIBBLE-045, scribbles the band about it.

FX-SCRIBBLE-045.says: The two-point mask, Centered Edge, Edge Width 2.

FX-SCRIBBLE-046.says: Angle keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 90 at frame 4: the lines turn.

FX-SCRIBBLE-047.says: Opacity keyed from 40 to 100 by an ease that passes its end: held at 100 at frame 2.

FX-SCRIBBLE-048.says: Colour written in capitals, #FF3020: FX-SCRIBBLE-002's frame.

FX-SCRIBBLE-049.says: Mask 1 with no masks at all. Nothing to scribble: the layer is drawn without the effect, which is kept as written, and EFFECT_PATH_MISSING is said every frame.

FX-SCRIBBLE-050.says: Mask 3, of two. Nothing to scribble: the layer is drawn without the effect, which is kept as written, and EFFECT_PATH_MISSING is said every frame.

FX-SCRIBBLE-051.says: Mask 1, switched off. Nothing to scribble: the layer is drawn without the effect, which is kept as written, and EFFECT_PATH_MISSING is said every frame.

FX-SCRIBBLE-052.says: All Masks, every mask switched off. Nothing to scribble: the layer is drawn without the effect, which is kept as written, and EFFECT_PATH_MISSING is said every frame.

FX-SCRIBBLE-053.says: All Masks Using Modes with no masks at all. Nothing to scribble: the layer is drawn without the effect, which is kept as written, and EFFECT_PATH_MISSING is said every frame.

FX-SCRIBBLE-054.says: Mask 0, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
